ideas.pitch: A real-time logistics optimizer for local delivery fleets that dynamically reroutes drivers based on live urban air quality sensors and traffic density.
ideas.title: EcoRoute NEXORA
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the concrete measurable environmental impact pattern from winning projects, offering a clear quantified reduction in carbon emissions that appeals to judges looking for practical real-world value.

ideas.pitch: A multilingual offline-first OCR and vision tool that translates handwritten rural prescription sheets into structured digital medication schedules with audio reminders.
ideas.title: MediLens AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets accessibility and public health challenges by combining multilingual support with computer vision, echoing the high-impact social utility of past winning healthcare bots.

ideas.pitch: A smart queue and resource booking platform designed for university administration offices, featuring predictive wait-time analytics and automated SMS ticketing.
ideas.title: CampusQueue
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate, universally understood pain point on university campuses where the hackathon is likely hosted, ensuring high judge empathy and straightforward prototype validation.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered micro-credential generator that analyzes local student project portfolios and auto-generates verified skill badges mapped directly to current regional job market demands.
ideas.title: SkillBridge Pro
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with student-focused themes by directly addressing employment readiness, providing judges with a tangible utility for career development.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight mobile web tool that allows farmers to upload smartphone photos of crop leaves for instant disease detection and localized fertilizer recommendations.
ideas.title: AgroInspect AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates high-impact agricultural problem-solving with a polished mobile-first UI that can be fully demonstrated live to judges in under 3 minutes.
